tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search current baby & kids brand discount offers on Cubbie Club by brand name, keyword, or product type (e.g. 'stroller', 'diapers', 'muffins', 'swim'). Returns each discount and a link to unlock it. Promo codes are revealed free after a quick signup at the link; they are not returned here.

tools.name: get_brand_offer
tools.description: Get the current Cubbie Club discount for a specific baby or kids brand by name. Returns the discount and the page where a member unlocks the code free.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List all baby & kids brands that currently have a live discount on Cubbie Club, with the discount and link for each.
